title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
summary: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. Existing latent action models infer actions from visual transitions, but their representations often entangle the underlying action with irrelevant visual variations, limiting transfer across embodiments. We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner. Our approach extracts compact latent actions from the video model's rich spatiotemporal features, compressing each latent video frame by $\boldsymbol{300\times}$ ($\boldsymbol{1{,}200 \rightarrow 4}$ tokens). In addition, by leveraging the video model's generative prior, these latent actions capture action-relevant dynamics disentangled from visual appearance. The resulting latent space serves as a shared action interface across embodiments (human and robot), environments, and action parameterizations. On LARY-Bench, DreamX achieves state-of-the-art performance among latent action models. Moreover, actions encoded in one setting remain effective in another: the latent space supports any-to-any video transfer and zero-shot action transfer across diverse embodiments and environments. Furthermore, this shared interface also enables policy learning in a compact latent action space, reducing the computational cost of video-diffusion-based policies.

AI.title_zh: DreamX：视频扩散模型是通用的潜在动作学习器
AI.abstract_zh: 从视频中学习通用动作表征，需要对同一动作在不同执行之间保持一致、同时对具身体现（embodiment）与外观变化保持不变的动力学进行建模。现有的潜在动作模型从视觉转移中推断动作，但其表征往往将底层动作与无关的视觉变化纠缠在一起，限制了跨具身体现的迁移。我们提出 DreamX，它将预训练视频扩散模型重新用作通用的潜在动作学习器。我们的方法从视频模型丰富的时空特征中提取紧凑的潜在动作，将每个潜在视频帧压缩 $\boldsymbol{300\times}$（$\boldsymbol{1{,}200 \rightarrow 4}$ 个 token）。此外，通过利用视频模型的生成先验，这些潜在动作能够捕捉与视觉外观解耦的动作相关动力学。所得的潜在空间可作为跨具身体现（人类与机器人）、环境以及动作参数化的共享动作接口。在 LARY-Bench 上，DreamX 在潜在动作模型中取得了最先进的性能。此外，在一种设定下编码的动作在另一种设定下仍然有效：该潜在空间支持任意到任意的视频迁移，以及跨多样具身体现与环境的零样本动作迁移。进一步地，这一共享接口还支持在紧凑的潜在动作空间中进行策略学习，从而降低基于视频扩散的策略的计算成本。

title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
comment: 59 pages, 21 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://cognitive-symbiont.github.io
summary: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf. Yet people still forget what they once knew, miss what they are not looking at, fail to find the right words, and face hard choices without the benefit of their own history, because the machine that could help stands outside the situation. As AI moves into the physical world, attention has settled on one kind of intelligent individual, the embodied robot; we argue that the era of Physical AI holds a second kind of equal importance, the person augmented by AI. Alongside artificial general intelligence, which asks how intelligent a machine can be, stands AI-augmented human intelligence (AHI), which asks how much intelligence a machine can enable in a particular person. Realizing it calls for a new kind of system, a cognitive symbiont: a lifelong, embedded, real-time, private, low-friction, and proactive companion that senses what the person senses through external devices, keeps their context across years, models their situation and their mind, takes part in their thinking at the right moment, carries out everyday tasks with their context, and keeps learning the person as both change. We give the paradigm a conceptual core, the cognitive gap between what a person could bring to a situation and what they can hold in working memory, and organize its design space as a symbiosis loop of sensing, keeping, understanding, living alongside, acting for and thinking with the person, and growing, enclosed by a personal runtime and by trust. Because a symbiont changes what a person can do in front of others, it also raises risks of a new kind, from covert assistance in examinations to pressure on everyone to adopt it, and we treat their governance as part of the paradigm.

AI.title_zh: 从自主智能体到认知共生体：迈向AI增强的人类智能
AI.abstract_zh: 十年来，人工智能的进展一直以机器能独自完成多少任务来衡量。大型基础模型如今能够编写代码并执行多步任务，个人智能体也能代人行使其意志。然而，人们仍然会忘记自己曾经知道的东西，错过自己未曾注视的事物，找不到恰当的措辞，并在没有自身历史经验助益的情况下面对艰难抉择，因为那个本可提供帮助的机器置身于情境之外。随着人工智能进入物理世界，人们的注意力集中于一种智能个体，即具身机器人；我们认为，物理AI（Physical AI）时代还包含第二种同等重要的智能个体，即由AI增强的人。与追问机器能有多智能的人工通用智能并列，存在着AI增强的人类智能（AI-augmented human intelligence, AHI），它追问的是机器能在某一个特定的人身上激发出多少智能。实现这一目标需要一种新型系统，即认知共生体（cognitive symbiont）：一个终身的、嵌入式的、实时的、私密的、低摩擦的且主动的伙伴，它通过外部设备感知人所感知之物，跨数年保存其上下文，对其情境与其心智进行建模，在恰当时机参与其思考，结合其上下文执行日常任务，并在人与系统双方不断变化的过程中持续学习这个人。我们为该范式给出了一个概念内核，即一个人面对某一情境时本可调用的能力与其工作记忆所能容纳的能力之间的认知鸿沟（cognitive gap），并将其设计空间组织为一个共生回路（symbiosis loop），包括感知、保存、理解、共同生活、代其行动以及与之共同思考并共同成长，该回路由个人运行时（personal runtime）与信任所包围。由于共生体会改变一个人在他人面前所能做到的事，它也带来了新型风险，从考试中的隐蔽协助到对所有人形成的采用压力，我们将对此类风险的治理视为该范式的一部分。

title: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
summary: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candidate for each task while balancing performance and computational cost? In this work, we present Route Anything, a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems. We develop a unified theoretical foundation that characterizes optimal routing under quality--cost trade-offs and establishes how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance. To systematically investigate routing across diverse capabilities, we first construct an omni-modal trajectory matrix spanning 25 benchmarks across language understanding, image, video, and speech generation, coding and workplace agents, and robotic manipulation, comprising 374,401 scored runs from 452 candidate configurations. Building on this framework, we train and test different routers to investigate the potential of omni-modal model routing, the capabilities of learned routers, and the conditions under which routing improves efficiency. Our results reveal substantial opportunities for capability orchestration: per-input oracle routing outperforms the best fixed candidate by 5.4 points, and learned routers outperform it by 0.3 points across 16 benchmarks, by 2.1 points on video generation, and by 1.1 points on robot manipulation while using 24% less policy time. More importantly, routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.

AI.title_zh: Route Anything：面向通用人工智能系统的模型路由与策略路由研究
AI.abstract_zh: 通用人工智能（AGI）需要一种能够在多样领域与模态之间理解、生成、推理和行动的方法。如今，通往 AGI 的一条有前景的路径并非依赖单一模型掌握所有能力，而是将专业化模型、工具与策略（候选）构成的异构生态编排为一个统一的 AI 系统。这一愿景的核心在于一个根本性问题：AI 系统如何能够为每个任务动态选择并协调最有能力的候选，同时在性能与计算成本之间取得平衡？在本工作中，我们提出 Route Anything，一个用于研究通用人工智能系统中模型路由与策略路由的统一框架。我们建立了一个统一的理论基础，刻画质量—成本权衡下的最优路由，并确立路由器的可用信息如何决定其可达性能。为系统性地研究跨多样能力的路由，我们首先构建了一个全模态轨迹矩阵，涵盖语言理解、图像、视频与语音生成、编程与职场智能体以及机器人操作等领域的 25 个基准，包含来自 452 个候选配置的 374,401 次带评分的运行。基于该框架，我们训练并测试了不同的路由器，以探究全模态模型路由的潜力、学习得到的路由器的能力，以及路由在何种条件下能够提升效率。我们的结果揭示了能力编排的巨大机遇：逐输入 oracle 路由在 16 个基准上比最佳固定候选高出 5.4 分，而学习得到的路由器比其高出 0.3 分，在视频生成上高出 2.1 分，在机器人操作上高出 1.1 分，同时策略时间减少 24%。更重要的是，与参考模型相比，路由平均将效率提升 8.82 倍。

title: HLO-AMP: Hierarchical Loco-Manipulation from Object-Aware Motion Priors
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). Video: https://youtu.be/viR_ULnRDQQ
summary: Hierarchical pipelines for humanoid loco-manipulation typically pair a task-agnostic whole-body controller (WBC) with a downstream task policy. Such WBCs are often trained through manual reward shaping, which yields visibly machine-like motions; more consequentially, they are trained without the manipulated object in the scene. Object dynamics are instead approximated through randomized end-effector force disturbances, a proxy that fails to reproduce the distributed multi-contact wrench a real payload applies across the arms and torso, with the gap becoming critical near the platform's payload limit. In this work, we train the low-level (LL) controller itself as an object-aware motion prior: a single policy trained via motion imitation on retargeted motion-capture (MoCap) references that span the core motion primitives of the downstream task, with the manipulated object physically present in the scene. This single stage inherits natural human-like coordination from the references and absorbs the realistic contact wrench at its source, while exposing the same compact task-space command interface used by command-tracking WBCs. A reference-free high-level (HL) policy is then trained on top, with its action channel anchored to the empirical envelope of the low-level training data so that it generalizes the priors to a long-horizon multi-stage task while structurally preventing queries that would push the low level off-distribution. We instantiate the framework on a Unitree G1 for bimanual box pick-and-place: the same deployed policy generalizes across object masses and dimensions, initial and goal poses, and reactively recovers from intentional drops mid-carry. Video: https://youtu.be/viR_ULnRDQQ.

AI.title_zh: HLO-AMP：基于物体感知运动先验的分层移动操作
AI.abstract_zh: 用于人形机器人移动操作的分层流水线通常将任务无关的全身控制器（WBC）与下游任务策略配对。此类WBC往往通过人工奖励塑形训练，产生肉眼可见的机械式动作；更具后果的是，它们在训练时场景中并不包含被操作物体。物体动力学改为通过随机化的末端执行器力扰动来近似，这种替代方式无法再现真实负载施加在双臂与躯干上的分布式多接触力旋量（wrench），当接近平台的负载极限时，这一差距变得尤为关键。在本工作中，我们将低层（LL）控制器本身训练为物体感知的运动先验：一个单一策略，通过在被重定向的运动捕捉（MoCap）参考上进行运动模仿来训练，这些参考覆盖下游任务的核心运动基元，且被操作物体在场景中物理存在。这一单一阶段从参考中继承了自然的类人协调性，并在其源头吸收了真实的接触力旋量，同时暴露出与命令跟踪型WBC相同的紧凑任务空间命令接口。随后在其之上训练一个无参考的高层（HL）策略，其动作通道锚定于低层训练数据的经验包络（empirical envelope），从而将这些先验泛化到长时程多阶段任务，同时在结构上防止查询将低层推离分布。我们在Unitree G1上以双臂箱体拾取放置任务实例化该框架：同一部署策略可泛化到不同的物体质量与尺寸、初始与目标位姿，并能在搬运途中对有意掉落进行反应式恢复。视频：https://youtu.be/viR_ULnRDQQ。

title: Trajectory Evaluation via Rollout-Free World Model for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
summary: Although existing candidate trajectory evaluators have substantially improved end-to-end planning accuracy, their underlying mechanism remains suboptimal. Model-based evaluators typically make scoring future-aware by explicitly predicting candidate-conditioned future states over the planning horizon, which we term rollout. However, rollout incurs high inference cost and accumulates prediction errors. We argue that planning does not require reconstructing a full future scene for each candidate, but only future-relevant information for reliable comparison. We therefore propose RFWorld, a Rollout-Free World model for end-to-end trajectory evaluation. RFWorld constructs a shared scene memory and shapes it into a future-readable representation via lightweight training-time temporal readout with semantic supervision, keeping training overhead low. At inference time, candidate trajectories directly query the shared memory via sparse spatial readout for scoring, reducing computation by roughly the planning horizon times the number of candidate trajectories, while avoiding recursive rollout errors. Experiments on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive show that RFWorld learns a more planning-aligned world representation and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.title_zh: 基于无滚动世界模型的端到端自动驾驶轨迹评估
AI.abstract_zh: 尽管现有的候选轨迹评估器已大幅提升了端到端规划精度，但其底层机制仍非最优。基于模型的评估器通常通过在规划时域上显式预测以候选轨迹为条件的未来状态来使评分具备未来感知能力，我们将这一过程称为滚动（rollout）。然而，滚动会带来高昂的推理开销并累积预测误差。我们认为，规划并不需要为每个候选轨迹重建完整的未来场景，而只需获取对未来可靠比较而言相关的信息。因此，我们提出 RFWorld，一种用于端到端轨迹评估的无滚动世界模型（Rollout-Free World model）。RFWorld 构建共享场景记忆，并通过带有语义监督的轻量级训练期时序读出将其塑造成可被未来读取的表示，从而保持较低的训练开销。在推理时，候选轨迹通过稀疏空间读出直接查询该共享记忆以进行评分，将计算量减少约「规划时域×候选轨迹数量」倍，同时避免递归滚动误差。在 NAVSIM 和 Bench2Drive 上的实验表明，RFWorld 学习到了与规划更对齐的世界表示，并取得了最先进的性能。

title: FloMo: 3D Scene Flow as a World Action Model Intermediate for Learning from Human Video
summary: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. Replacing motion prediction with a video prediction objective degrades out-of-distribution generalization, while adding a video prediction target alongside motion lowers policy success rather than improving it. When motion, video, and action are predicted jointly, action tokens attend far more to motion than to video, suggesting that predicting video wastes model capacity. Together, these results indicate that motion effectively mediates the transfer from video pretraining to action. More information can be found at flomo-wam.github.io.

AI.title_zh: FloMo：将三维场景流作为世界动作模型中间表示以从人类视频中学习
AI.abstract_zh: 预训练视频生成模型将互联网规模的运动先验蒸馏进机器人策略，但完整视频对于动作预测而言是一种冗余信号。我们认为，稠密三维运动是视频预训练最佳地迁移到机器人动作的媒介，并且预测运动而非视频能够为动作预测带来更好的样本效率。FloMo 是一个 5B 视频生成模型，经微调以预测三维场景流和动作 token。将场景流渲染为 RGB 并将其编码到与视频相同的潜在空间中，使得预训练视频生成骨干网络能够高效地适应于预测三维场景流。我们的模型在无动作的人类视频与带动作标签的机器人遥操作数据上联合训练，受益于人类视频预训练，并能泛化到未见过的物体、运动基元和任务。将运动预测替换为视频预测目标会降低分布外泛化能力，而在运动之外增加视频预测目标会降低策略成功率，而非提升它。当运动、视频和动作被联合预测时，动作 token 对运动的注意力远多于对视频的注意力，这表明预测视频浪费了模型容量。总之，这些结果表明运动有效地中介了从视频预训练到动作的迁移。更多信息可在 flomo-wam.github.io 找到。

title: Do Agentic Policies Need to Look at Every Step? Geometric Abstraction for Reasoning and Action
comment: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Agentic Robotics. 13 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://geometric-abstraction.github.io
summary: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.

AI.title_zh: 智能体策略需要对每一步都进行观察吗？用于推理与行动的几何抽象
AI.abstract_zh: 近期的多模态语言模型能够直接对机器人场景进行推理，但目前尚不清楚它们是否需要在交互的每一步都反复重新解读原始视觉观察。我们提出通过一种三维几何抽象，将常规的空间推理从图像转移到文本与符号上，该抽象会基于观察进行局部刷新，并由语言模型直接读取。具体而言，我们的接口通过类型化、具备证据感知的符号引用来表示物体部件的场景几何，从经过标定的 RGB-D 中对其进行接地，并在每次动作后返回带有度量残差的紧凑文本检查点。由此，符号化的任务结构可以跨决策复用，而度量值则重新绑定到当前场景，直接的视觉推理仅按需调用。在离线策略合成与连续在线执行中，基于已接地文本与符号的推理提升了多步操作任务的完成度，同时大幅减少了重复的多模态查询，从而将显式几何状态确立为智能体机器人策略的一种有效基础。

title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
summary: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory. Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure. This work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP), a replay-free method that estimates the historical importance of adaptable model tensors from sample-level action gradients weighted by local trajectory-amplification risk. A ridge-regularized local linear model is fitted to expert state-action transitions, and the largest singular value of its state-transition matrix provides a policy-independent, Lyapunov-inspired estimate of one-step perturbation amplification. After each task, risk-weighted squared gradients are accumulated in a tensor-level importance memory. During subsequent tasks, DRAP uses normalized cumulative importance to scale the effective AdamW learning rate of each tensor, immediately reducing the plasticity of components that supported previous behavior at dynamically sensitive trajectory points. We instantiate DRAP on a fixed KappaTune-selected subnetwork of OpenVLA and evaluate replay-free sequential adaptation across the LIBERO Spatial, Object, and Goal suites. Compared with standard AdamW fine-tuning and EWC, the results show substantially improved retention of previously learned behaviors while preserving strong new-suite acquisition.

AI.title_zh: DRAP：面向物理AI持续学习的动力学风险自适应可塑性
AI.abstract_zh: 物理AI中的持续学习不同于传统的持续学习，因为每步微小的策略误差会在轨迹上累积。每一次偏差都可能使智能体偏离训练分布，增大后续预测误差，并最终导致闭环任务失败。本文提出动力学风险自适应可塑性（Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity, DRAP），这是一种无需回放（replay-free）的方法，它从按局部轨迹放大风险加权的样本级动作梯度中估计可适应模型张量的历史重要性。将岭正则化的局部线性模型拟合到专家状态-动作转移上，其状态转移矩阵的最大奇异值提供了一个与策略无关、受Lyapunov启发的单步扰动放大估计。在每个任务之后，风险加权的梯度平方被累积到张量级重要性记忆中。在后续任务中，DRAP使用归一化的累积重要性来缩放每个张量的有效AdamW学习率，立即降低那些在动力学敏感轨迹点上支撑过先前行为的组件的可塑性。我们在OpenVLA中由KappaTune选定的固定子网络上实例化DRAP，并在LIBERO Spatial、Object和Goal套件上评估无回放的顺序适应。与标准AdamW微调和EWC相比，结果表明，先前学习行为的保持能力得到显著提升，同时保持了强大的新套件获取能力。

title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
summary: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.

AI.title_zh: 视频生成背后：来自 Kling 的多模态理解观察与洞见
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成已从孤立的片段发展到连贯的短视频视听序列，其瓶颈正从渲染转向语义控制。本报告总结了从 Kling 历代版本中获得的多模态理解方面的观察与洞见。我们认为，生成质量是多模态理解在整条数据—条件—对齐—评估链条上的投影，并逐模块考察了这一链条。Kling-MLLM 是一个共享的多模态基础模型，统一了图像、视频、音频、同步音视频以及交错输入，并针对每个下游模块进行了专门化。由于 DiT 的训练样本数远少于语言模型，我们将字幕（captioning）视为一种语义契约，以最大化描述密度，并将其扩展为基于参考的字幕（reference-grounded captioning），使参考绑定显式化。提示增强（prompt enhancement）将用户意图转译到这一字幕分布中：基础 PE 由优质视频的字幕导出，并通过文本级与生成器在环（generator-in-the-loop）强化学习进行精炼；而智能体式 PE（agentic PE）则精炼故事并检索优质示例。我们表明，可靠的文本编码器来自感知训练，而非来自更强的语言能力；并且可以在端到端训练之前仅凭文本筛选候选。奖励建模（reward modeling）将用于可解释、局部化批评的通用奖励模型与用于快速多维评分的决策奖励模型配对，并将感知带宽（perceptual bandwidth）视为一等设计参数。最后，我们回顾了针对特定任务的自动评估，重点关注那些能暴露评分捷径并有助于将失败追溯到其上游来源的协议。我们希望这些经验能为构建可控视频生成背后的理解栈提供实用指导。

title: Trusting Imagined Futures: Auditing Imagined Rewards for VLA Post-Training
summary: Video world models enable candidate actions to be evaluated through imagined outcomes, but high predicted rewards can favor trajectories with poor execution quality. We introduce Trusting Imagined Futures (TIF), an offline supervision selection method for vision-language-action (VLA) post-training that audits predicted rewards using execution feedback. A multidimensional reward model predicts a utility score for candidate ranking and five dimensions of execution quality. An auditor uses reward predictions and uncertainty to identify overestimation patterns learned from paired imagined videos and real executions. TIF accepts the candidate with the highest predicted utility when its advantage over the existing trajectory exceeds a margin and its audit risk passes a threshold; otherwise, it retains the existing supervision. The retained real trajectories then supervise behavior cloning. Across four LIBERO suites and three training seeds, TIF achieves a mean success rate of 76.25%, improving over training on the existing trajectories by 3.00 percentage points with the same trajectory count and training budget. Adding audit gating yields 1.47 percentage points with the reward model and advantage margin held fixed. The gains persist against advantage ranking and logistic regression risk selection at matched replacement counts. On recorded videos from three real robot tasks, TIF increases clean completion among selected trajectories from 58.33% to 70.00% across 60 candidate pools.

AI.title_zh: 信任想象的未来：审计VLA后训练中的想象奖励
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型使得候选动作能够通过想象的结果被评估，但高预测奖励可能偏向于执行质量差的轨迹。我们提出信任想象的未来（Trusting Imagined Futures, TIF），一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）后训练的离线监督选择方法，它利用执行反馈来审计预测奖励。一个多维奖励模型预测用于候选排序的效用分数以及执行质量的五个维度。一个审计器利用奖励预测和不确定性来识别从成对的想象视频与真实执行中学到的过高估计模式。当候选相对于现有轨迹的优势超过一个余量（margin）且其审计风险通过阈值时，TIF接受预测效用最高的候选；否则，它保留现有监督。随后，保留下来的真实轨迹用于监督行为克隆。在四个LIBERO套件和三个训练种子上，TIF取得了76.25%的平均成功率，在相同的轨迹数量和训练预算下，相比在现有轨迹上训练提升了3.00个百分点。在奖励模型和优势余量保持固定的情况下，加入审计门控带来了1.47个百分点的提升。在匹配替换数量的情况下，相较于优势排序和逻辑回归风险选择，这些增益依然存在。在来自三个真实机器人任务的录制视频上，TIF在60个候选池中将所选轨迹中的干净完成率从58.33%提高到70.00%。

title: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
summary: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.

AI.title_zh: PrimeSim：一个基于大规模跨本体演示的通用世界模型模拟器
AI.abstract_zh: 一个作为模拟器的机器人世界模型不能仅仅生成看似合理的视频：它必须忠实地遵循指令动作、保持跨摄像机视角的一致性，并维持连贯的长时程推演（rollout）。我们提出 PrimeSim，一个以动作为条件的多视角世界模型模拟器，通过渐进式中期训练（midtrain）与后训练（posttrain）来应对这些挑战。我们从一个预训练视频生成器出发，在涵盖 22 个平台的 30,110 小时机器人演示数据上进行中期训练。为提升动作遵循能力，我们引入统一的跨本体动作表示与帧对齐的双路径条件注入（frame-aligned dual-path conditioning），以强化动作与帧之间的对应关系。为保持多视角一致性，我们设计了带有显式摄像机标识的视角感知交错注意力（view-aware interleaved attention），在保留各视角特有表示的同时实现跨视角信息交换。我们进一步提出"快视频、慢记忆"（fast-video, slow-memory）后训练框架，将双向视频生成器转变为高效的自回归模拟器。通过结合快速因果生成、自推演训练（self-rollout training）与分层时间记忆，PrimeSim 缓解了由自生成历史带来的误差累积，并支持连贯的长时程仿真。PrimeSim 以 10.1 FPS 运行，在刚体与可变形物体操作任务的长时程推演中保持稳定，并能在 100 至 200 个梯度步内迁移到留出平台，而预训练骨干网络无法做到这一点。在与五个开源动作条件世界模型的对比中，它在 WorldSimProbe 的五套评测中领先四套，并取得最佳的 EWMBench 总体得分，但细粒度局部校准仍落后于该领域其他方法；其推演结果足够忠实，可支持基于 GRPO 的策略优化。我们开源模型权重、推理代码与训练代码。

title: Pixel-space video generation with U-JiT
summary: Latent diffusion and flow matching models are ubiquitous in state-of-the-art generative video models. While highly effective, relying on pretrained autoencoders to compress the data into a lower-dimensional latent space also comes with drawbacks. First, training proceeds in two stages: autoencoder pretraining, with compression and reconstruction objectives, followed by latent generative model training, precluding fully end-to-end training. Second, autoencoders also lead to an inherent loss of signal, and the trade-off between reconstruction quality and generative performance in the latent space is still an active area of research. In this paper we explore the viability of generative video models directly in pixel space. We analyze recent approaches in pixel-space generative modeling of images that rely on basic transformer designs, and identify several shortcomings that limit their effectiveness for the high-dimensional pixel-space video generation. To overcome these limitations, we propose a UNet-like transformer architecture along with improvements to the training recipe and sampling strategy. We conduct controlled experiments, training latent and pixel-space models from scratch on Kinetics-600. For the standard frames-to-video task at 128 resolution, our U-JiT model improves generative FVD by 27% over prior state-of-the-art results, and by 14% against the JiT pixel-space baseline. Scaling to higher 256 resolution, we find the improvement over pixel-space and latent-based models grows as we increase the spatiotemporal compression rate up to $64 \times 64 \times 8$. Finally, we find that U-JiT improves per-frame FID by 27% over latent models and 61% over pixel-space models on class-to-video generation, with respectively 9% and 56% reduction in FVD.

AI.title_zh: 基于 U-JiT 的像素空间视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 潜空间扩散与流匹配模型在最先进的生成式视频模型中无处不在。尽管非常有效，但依赖预训练自编码器将数据压缩到低维潜空间也带来了若干缺点。首先，训练分两个阶段进行：先以压缩与重建为目标预训练自编码器，再训练潜空间生成模型，因而无法实现完全端到端的训练。其次，自编码器还会导致固有的信号损失，而重建质量与潜空间生成性能之间的权衡仍是一个活跃的研究领域。本文中，我们探索了直接在像素空间中构建生成式视频模型的可行性。我们分析了近期依赖基础 Transformer 设计的图像像素空间生成建模方法，并指出若干限制其在高维像素空间视频生成中有效性的不足。为克服这些局限，我们提出了一种类 UNet 的 Transformer 架构，并对训练配方与采样策略进行了改进。我们开展了受控实验，在 Kinetics-600 上从头训练潜空间模型与像素空间模型。在 128 分辨率的标准化帧到视频任务上，我们的 U-JiT 模型相较于此前的最先进结果将生成 FVD 提升了 27%，相较于 JiT 像素空间基线提升了 14%。当扩展至更高的 256 分辨率时，我们发现，随着我们将时空压缩率提高至 $64 \times 64 \times 8$，相较于像素空间模型与基于潜空间的模型的改进幅度随之增大。最后，我们发现，在类别到视频生成任务上，U-JiT 相较潜空间模型将逐帧 FID 提升了 27%，相较像素空间模型提升了 61%，FVD 分别降低了 9% 和 56%。

title: A research world model of power engineering learns its dynamics and reveals what-ifs
summary: Decisions about the direction of research in power engineering determine which technologies mature and, through them, shape infrastructure that lasts decades, yet their consequences cannot be observed before they are taken, and existing forecasts of research fields extrapolate a single trajectory. Here we introduce research world models, which treat a research field as a dynamical system that can be acted upon, and establish one for power engineering from 1.1 million papers. A distilled language model reads each paper into role-typed concepts, two sophisticated, high-fidelity graph-temporal neural network cores learn how the resulting concept network evolves, and operators learned from natural experiments in the publication record estimate the effects of interventions. In temporally held-out tests, the model forecast years ahead which concepts would grow and which method-target pairs would be joined for the first time, outperforming tuned machine-learning baselines in most settings, and its estimated intervention effects tracked those realized in natural experiments it had not seen. Its training scheme and three of its operators replicated in two fields withheld from development. Questions posed in natural language are compiled by a domain-specialized 27-billion-parameter language model into executable actions and answered as paired simulations with and without the intervention. The answers were rated 4.1 of 5 for faithfulness by an independent language-model judge. By revealing the latent dynamics of a research field and its response to interventions, research world models offer a new way to simulate and test research decisions before they are made.

AI.title_zh: 一个电力工程研究世界模型学习其动力学并揭示反事实假设
AI.abstract_zh: 关于电力工程研究方向的决定决定了哪些技术得以成熟，并通过这些技术塑造延续数十年的基础设施，然而其后果在决定作出之前无法被观察到，而现有对研究领域的预测只是外推单一轨迹。在此，我们提出研究世界模型（research world models），它将一个研究领域视为一个可施加作用的动力系统，并基于110万篇论文为电力工程建立了一个这样的模型。一个经过蒸馏的语言模型将每篇论文读取为角色类型化概念，两个复杂的高保真图-时序神经网络核心学习所得到的概念网络如何演化，而从出版记录中的自然实验学习得到的算子估计干预的效果。在时间上留出的测试中，该模型提前数年预测了哪些概念将会增长以及哪些方法-目标对将首次结合，在大多数设置下优于经过调优的机器学习基线，并且其估计的干预效果与其未曾见过的自然实验中实际实现的效果相吻合。其训练方案及其三个算子在两个未参与开发的领域中得到了复现。以自然语言提出的问题由一个领域专门化的270亿参数语言模型编译为可执行动作，并作为有干预与无干预的成对模拟来回答。这些答案被一个独立语言模型评判者评为忠实度4.1分（满分5分）。通过揭示一个研究领域的潜在动力学及其对干预的响应，研究世界模型提供了一种在作出研究决定之前对其进行模拟和检验的新方法。

title: Future Representation Distillation for Imagination-Free World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) use the predictive knowledge of pretrained video diffusion models for robot control through future video prediction. However, iterative video denoising is costly, and inaccurate visual predictions can compromise action prediction. Our key idea is to make this predictive knowledge available through visual representations computed from the current observation, enabling action prediction without generating future videos. We introduce DreamFree, a WAM that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a predictive visual encoder through representation distillation. The visual encoder learns to predict a frozen video diffusion model's representation using only the current observation. An action module is then trained to predict actions by extracting action-relevant information from the visual encoder. Across real-world and simulated tasks, DreamFree achieves higher success rates than state-of-the-art VLAs and WAMs, while performing real-time closed-loop control at 11Hz with a 14B video diffusion backbone. Experiments show that DreamFree can translate stronger video priors and additional video data into better robot control and enable learning new robot tasks from video demonstrations, including videos from a different embodiment, without action annotation for the new tasks.

AI.title_zh: 面向免想象世界动作模型的未来表征蒸馏
AI.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）通过未来视频预测，利用预训练视频扩散模型的预测知识进行机器人控制。然而，迭代式视频去噪代价高昂，且不准确的视觉预测可能损害动作预测。我们的核心思想是：通过由当前观测计算得到的视觉表征来提供这种预测知识，从而无需生成未来视频即可实现动作预测。我们提出 DreamFree，这是一种通过表征蒸馏将预训练视频扩散模型复用为预测性视觉编码器的 WAM。该视觉编码器学习仅使用当前观测来预测一个冻结的视频扩散模型的表征。随后，动作模块通过从视觉编码器中提取与动作相关的信息来训练预测动作。在真实世界与仿真任务中，DreamFree 取得了高于最先进 VLA 和 WAM 的成功率，同时以 11Hz 的实时闭环控制运行，并采用 14B 视频扩散骨干网络。实验表明，DreamFree 能够将更强的视频先验和额外的视频数据转化为更好的机器人控制，并能够从视频演示中学习新的机器人任务，包括来自不同具身形态（embodiment）的视频，而无需为新任务提供动作标注。

title: Physical Diffusion Policy via MPM-Guided 3D Gaussian Simulation
summary: Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse everyday objects remains challenging because objects with different materials exhibit distinct deformation and contact dynamics. While diffusion policies provide a powerful framework for modeling multimodal manipulation behaviors, they typically lack explicit physical reasoning and may produce averaged actions when facing heterogeneous objects. We present a physics-aware diffusion policy that augments visual imitation learning with object physical understanding. Our framework recovers material properties from visual demonstrations by coupling 3D Gaussian Splatting with differentiable Material Point Method simulation, where video guidance and particle-level constraints enable accurate physical parameter estimation. The estimated physics conditions are further integrated into a material-aware Mixture-of-Experts diffusion policy, allowing adaptive behavior generation across different physical regimes. For practical deployment, we introduce a physics memory bank that provides efficient physical retrieval without requiring online simulation optimization. Experiments on a wide range of simulated and real-world objects demonstrate improved manipulation success and generalization over existing diffusion-based approaches. These results show that incorporating physical knowledge is critical for scalable robot manipulation in diverse environments.

AI.title_zh: 基于MPM引导三维高斯模拟的物理扩散策略
AI.abstract_zh: 学习面向多样日常物体的鲁棒操作策略仍然具有挑战性，因为不同材质的物体会表现出不同的形变与接触动力学。尽管扩散策略为建模多模态操作行为提供了强大的框架，但它们通常缺乏显式的物理推理，在面对异质物体时可能产生平均化的动作。我们提出一种物理感知的扩散策略，以物体的物理理解增强视觉模仿学习。我们的框架通过将三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）与可微的物质点法（Material Point Method）模拟相耦合，从视觉演示中恢复材料属性，其中视频引导与粒子级约束使得能够实现准确的物理参数估计。所估计的物理条件进一步被集成到材料感知的专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）扩散策略中，从而支持跨不同物理状态的自适应行为生成。为便于实际部署，我们引入物理记忆库（physics memory bank），无需在线模拟优化即可提供高效的物理检索。在广泛的仿真与真实世界物体上的实验表明，相较于现有的基于扩散的方法，本方法在操作成功率和泛化能力上均有所提升。这些结果表明，融入物理知识对于在多样环境中实现可扩展的机器人操作至关重要。

title: Hybrid Particle-Voxel Dynamics for Multimodal 3D World Simulation
summary: Predicting how the world evolves in response to robot actions is central to policy learning, evaluation, and planning. However, many action-conditioned world models predict future observations in 2D image or video space without explicitly modeling the underlying 3D scene, making spatial consistency across viewpoints and over long-horizon interactions challenging. We introduce 3D World Simulator, an action-conditioned multimodal world modeling framework that jointly predicts appearance, geometry, and tactile observations from a unified 3D representation. Our approach combines a hybrid particle-voxel autoencoder that compresses point clouds into compact 3D voxel latents with an action-conditioned latent dynamics model that predicts their evolution. The shared 3D representation supports geometrically consistent rendering from arbitrary viewpoints and flexible integration of spatially aligned tactile signals. Our experiments demonstrate interactive, long-horizon, multimodal prediction at 50 Hz. We then show how our model enables scalable data generation for policy training and evaluation using tactile and multi-view visual observations, including wrist-mounted and novel camera views. Furthermore, we scale our method to large datasets containing diverse objects and demonstrate model-based planning with unseen objects and robot configurations. Together, these results highlight the potential of hybrid particle-voxel dynamics as a foundation for multimodal 3D world simulation.

AI.title_zh: 面向多模态三维世界仿真的混合粒子-体素动力学
AI.abstract_zh: 预测世界如何随机器人动作而演化，是策略学习、评估与规划的核心。然而，许多以动作为条件的世界模型在二维图像或视频空间中预测未来观测，而没有显式地建模底层的三维场景，这使得跨视角以及长时程交互中的空间一致性变得困难。我们提出 3D World Simulator，一个以动作为条件的多模态世界建模框架，它从统一的三维表示中联合预测外观、几何与触觉观测。我们的方法将一个把点云压缩为紧凑三维体素潜变量的混合粒子-体素自编码器，与一个预测这些潜变量演化的以动作为条件的潜动力学模型相结合。该共享的三维表示支持从任意视角进行几何一致的渲染，并灵活集成空间对齐的触觉信号。我们的实验展示了在 50 Hz 下的交互式、长时程、多模态预测。随后我们展示了该模型如何利用触觉与多视角视觉观测（包括腕部安装相机和新颖相机视角）实现用于策略训练与评估的可扩展数据生成。此外，我们将方法扩展到包含多样物体的大型数据集，并展示了使用未见物体与机器人构型进行的基于模型的规划。综合来看，这些结果凸显了混合粒子-体素动力学作为多模态三维世界仿真基础的潜力。

title: DynOSeg: Dynamic Object Segmentation via Motion-Geometry Fusion
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 22 pages, including supplementary materials
summary: Moving Object Segmentation (MOS) detects and separates dynamic objects from the static background in a video, which plays a fundamental role in dynamic-scene understanding. Most MOS methods rely on pure visual motion cues alone, such as optical flow or point tracks, which is inherently ambiguous due to the compounded camera and object motions as well as motion-induced appearance changes, e.g. shadows and reflections. Naive fusion of additional information such as depth and semantics, however, cannot leverage their complementarity to the fullest extent. We therefore propose DynOSeg, a novel MOS approach that takes on a two-stage fusion structure. DynOSeg first combines a geometry-aware residual map and depth encoding into a geometric representation of motion, delineating camera motions and object dynamics. We then further incorporate semantic features to refine object understanding. We have additionally curated a diverse training corpus including CARLA-MOS, a new synthetic urban-driving dataset for MOS training. Our experiments show that DynOSeg consistently outperforms published state-of-the-art MOS methods across a diverse range of datasets. Our code and pretrained models can be found at https://github.com/ACFR-RPG/DynOSeg

AI.title_zh: DynOSeg：通过运动-几何融合的动态物体分割
AI.abstract_zh: 运动物体分割（Moving Object Segmentation, MOS）在视频中检测并将动态物体与静态背景分离，在动态场景理解中发挥着基础性作用。大多数 MOS 方法仅依赖纯视觉运动线索，例如光流或点轨迹（point tracks），由于相机运动与物体运动相互叠加，以及运动引起的外观变化（例如阴影和反射），这种方式本质上具有歧义性。然而，对深度和语义等附加信息进行简单融合，并不能最大限度地发挥其互补性。因此，我们提出了 DynOSeg，一种采用两阶段融合结构的新型 MOS 方法。DynOSeg 首先将几何感知的残差图与深度编码结合为运动的几何表示，从而刻画相机运动和物体动态。随后，我们进一步引入语义特征来细化对物体的理解。此外，我们还整理了一个多样化的训练语料库，其中包括 CARLA-MOS，一个用于 MOS 训练的新合成城市驾驶数据集。我们的实验表明，DynOSeg 在多种数据集上始终优于已发表的最先进 MOS 方法。我们的代码和预训练模型可在 https://github.com/ACFR-RPG/DynOSeg 获取。

title: IGSW: Multi-Weather Urban Scene Reconstruction with Intrinsic-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting
summary: High-fidelity weather editing of 4D scenes can support end-to-end training and closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving. Combining generative image editing with dynamic Gaussian representations enables multi-weather scene reconstruction, but weather-edited images often contain structural distortions. Directly fitting their appearance may propagate errors from teacher images into the reconstructed 4D scene, compromising the original scene structure and temporal continuity. To address these challenges, we propose IGSW, a two-stage framework that combines intrinsic-decoupled 4D Gaussian scene modeling with structure-preserving weather refinement. In Stage I, background Gaussian appearance is decomposed into weather-shared albedo and normals and weather-specific irradiance and residuals. Weather teacher images generated by a diffusion-based image editing model and intrinsic maps estimated by a diffusion-based inverse renderer provide feature-level soft supervision for stable structure and illumination changes. In Stage II, a structure-preservation gate combines semantic conflicts with cross-weather intrinsic discrepancies to suppress unreliable teacher regions. Per-Gaussian weather transport variables and target-weather branches then strengthen the desired weather appearance over the intrinsic-decoupled scene. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo show that IGSW achieves the highest content similarity and semantic consistency and the lowest temporal error among the compared methods, while retaining pronounced weather-dependent illumination and atmosphere. The project page is available at https://akaxi6.github.io/IGSW/ .

AI.title_zh: IGSW：基于本征解耦高斯泼溅的多天气城市场景重建
AI.abstract_zh: 对4D场景进行高保真天气编辑可为自动驾驶的端到端训练与闭环仿真提供支持。将生成式图像编辑与动态高斯表示相结合，可实现多天气场景重建，但经天气编辑的图像往往包含结构畸变。直接拟合其外观可能将教师图像中的误差传播到重建的4D场景中，从而损害原始场景结构与时间连续性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出IGSW，一个两阶段框架，将本征解耦的4D高斯场景建模与结构保持的天气精化相结合。在第一阶段，背景高斯外观被分解为天气共享的反照率与法线以及天气特定的辐照度与残差。由基于扩散的图像编辑模型生成的天气教师图像，以及由基于扩散的逆渲染器估计的本征图，为稳定的结构与光照变化提供特征级软监督。在第二阶段，结构保持门控将语义冲突与跨天气本征差异相结合，以抑制不可靠的教师区域。随后，逐高斯天气传输变量与目标天气分支在本征解耦场景之上强化期望的天气外观。在nuScenes和Waymo上的实验表明，IGSW在对比方法中取得最高的内容相似度与语义一致性以及最低的时间误差，同时保留了显著的依赖天气的光照与大气效果。项目页面见 https://akaxi6.github.io/IGSW/ 。

title: Embodied AI for Scientific Discovery: From Physical Action to Scientific Evidence
summary: Scientific experiments are increasingly selected, executed and interpreted by learned systems that act through physical interfaces. Robot learning builds physical competence, whereas AI for science chooses which experiment to run, each reporting different endpoints. This review treats their interface as one problem, embodied AI for science, where the experiment itself is partially observed: specimen state, apparatus state and measurement processes are latent, actions are costly and irreversible, and missingness depends on execution and outcome. We organize the literature by three closures operating at distinct levels: operational closure (the experiment realized is the one intended), epistemic closure (the result updates beliefs or selects subsequent experiments) and evidential closure (the record supports a claim). We analyze workflows through a record-linked evidence cycle - Record, Diagnose, Calibrate, Confirm - as analytic functions with feedback. A taxonomy crosses these closures with six delegated decisions and five embodiment classes. Our formulation separates commanded, realized and observed conditions and models diagnosis with explicit resource, risk and sample-change costs. We compare experiment-selection methods by terminal decision, review perception, protocol compilation, visuomotor policies, world models, recovery and transfer by evidence emission requirements, and compare chemistry, materials, biology, microscopy and field workflows by what their records establish. An appendix provides an evidence map of 28 workflows (26 physical, two software-boundary), characterizing validation pathways and claim confirmation requirements. We propose evaluation that separates actions, valid experiments, campaigns and confirmed claims, framing open challenges as controlled comparisons with measurable failure conditions.

AI.title_zh: 面向科学发现的具身人工智能：从物理动作到科学证据
AI.abstract_zh: 科学实验正日益由通过学习训练得到的系统来选取、执行和解释，这些系统通过物理接口行动。机器人学习构建物理能力，而科学人工智能（AI for science）选择运行哪一实验，二者报告的终端指标各不相同。本综述将二者的接口视为同一个问题，即科学具身人工智能（embodied AI for science），其中实验本身是被部分观测的：样本状态、仪器状态和测量过程均为潜在的，动作代价高昂且不可逆，并且缺失性取决于执行情况与结果。我们按照在三个不同层面上运作的三种闭合来组织文献：操作闭合（所实现的实验即为所意图的实验）、认知闭合（结果更新信念或选择后续实验）和证据闭合（记录支持某一主张）。我们通过一个与记录相联系的证据循环——记录（Record）、诊断（Diagnose）、校准（Calibrate）、确认（Confirm）——将工作流作为具有反馈的分析功能加以分析。一个分类法将上述闭合与六类被委托的决策和五种具身类别交叉。我们的表述区分了指令条件、实现条件和观测条件，并以显式的资源、风险和样本变更成本对诊断进行建模。我们按终端决策比较实验选择方法，按证据产出要求评述感知、协议编译、视觉运动策略、世界模型、恢复与迁移，并按其记录所确立的内容比较化学、材料、生物学、显微学和现场工作流。附录提供了28个工作流（26个物理工作流，2个软件边界工作流）的证据图谱，刻画了验证路径和主张确认要求。我们提出一种将动作、有效实验、实验战役（campaign）和已确认主张加以区分的评估，并将开放挑战表述为具有可测量失败条件的受控比较。

title: CounterSketch: Physics-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning for Sketch-to-Video Generation
summary: Counterfactual sketch animation explores how a static sketch evolves under a hypothetical intervention. We present CounterSketch, a physics-grounded framework that transforms natural-language ``What if...?'' queries into physically plausible sketch animations. The framework integrates VLM-guided scene grounding, causal event-chain reasoning, constraint-based trajectory generation, and verification. It models physical transitions to update the scene graph, computes continuous object trajectories, and validates them against physical, geometric, and semantic constraints. The verified trajectories are then projected into object-level motion bounding boxes to guide downstream sketch-video synthesis. Experiments on CounterSketchBench (80 questions) demonstrate that physics-grounded trajectories provide stronger motion guidance than direct VLM predictions.

AI.title_zh: CounterSketch：面向草图到视频生成的物理落地反事实推理
AI.abstract_zh: 反事实草图动画探究静态草图在假设性干预下如何演变。我们提出 CounterSketch，一个以物理为基础的框架，它将自然语言形式的“What if...?”（如果……会怎样？）查询转化为物理上合理的草图动画。该框架整合了 VLM 引导的场景落地（scene grounding）、因果事件链推理、基于约束的轨迹生成以及验证。它通过建模物理状态转移来更新场景图，计算连续的对象轨迹，并依据物理、几何与语义约束对轨迹进行验证。随后，经过验证的轨迹被投影为对象级运动边界框（motion bounding boxes），以指导下游的草图-视频合成。在 CounterSketchBench（80 个问题）上的实验表明，物理落地的轨迹比直接的 VLM 预测能提供更强的运动引导。

title: What Remains in Sight? Autoregressive Video Decoding as Representation-Guided Context Rewriting
summary: Long-horizon video generation is increasingly moving toward autoregressive rollout, where each newly generated segment becomes part of the evidence used for future prediction. Recent causal decoders, long-context training, and KV-cache mechanisms have extended feasible duration, but most inference pipelines still decide the visible past implicitly through recent windows, compressed caches, or external memory. This raises a direct question: \textbf{can the choice of which past frames or segments to show to the decoder be treated as an explicit test-time decision?} We answer this question with \textsc{ReCR}, a training-free method that formulates autoregressive video decoding as representation-guided context rewriting. At each step, \textsc{ReCR} builds a selected visible context from the generated history by using internal decoder representations to favor context units that match the global rollout state, avoid redundancy with the recent continuation, preserve temporal boundary coverage, and widen the range of spatial layouts in view. The selected units are then mapped onto a compact causal axis before decoding the next block. Across long-horizon text-to-video benchmarks, \textsc{ReCR} consistently improves multiple autoregressive backbones under matched visible-token budgets. Empirical analyses such as representation-space diagnostics and transition-count prompt switching further show that improving what remains visible is an effective path toward more stable long-video decoding.

AI.title_zh: 视野之内还剩什么？作为表征引导上下文重写的自回归视频解码
AI.abstract_zh: 长时程视频生成正日益转向自回归式展开（rollout），其中每个新生成的片段都会成为用于未来预测的证据的一部分。近期的因果解码器、长上下文训练与 KV 缓存机制延长了可行的时长，但大多数推理流程仍通过近期窗口、压缩缓存或外部记忆来隐式地决定可见的过去。这引出一个直接的问题：\textbf{能否将“向解码器展示哪些过去帧或片段”的选择视为一种显式的测试时决策？} 我们以 \textsc{ReCR} 回答这一问题，这是一种免训练方法，将自回归视频解码表述为表征引导的上下文重写。在每一步，\textsc{ReCR} 利用解码器内部表征，从已生成的历史中构建一个被选定的可见上下文，以偏向于与全局展开状态相匹配、避免与近期延续内容冗余、保持时间边界覆盖范围、并拓宽视野中空间布局范围的上下文单元。随后，在解码下一个块之前，将选定的单元映射到一个紧凑的因果轴上。在长时程文本到视频基准上，在匹配可见 token 预算的条件下，\textsc{ReCR} 一致地提升了多种自回归骨干模型的表现。诸如表征空间诊断与基于转移次数的提示切换等实证分析进一步表明，改善“仍然可见的内容”是通向更稳定的长视频解码的一条有效路径。

title: ScienceVision: Can AI Observe and Reason Like a Scientist?
summary: Scientific discovery builds on accurate observations interpreted through domain knowledge and reasoning. For scientific 3D data, this requires understanding structures and spatial relationships, from protein contacts to anatomical organization. Existing multimodal benchmarks largely evaluate text and 2D images, while scientific 3D evaluations vary in representations and protocols across disciplines, limiting cross-disciplinary comparison. To assess these foundational capabilities, we introduce ScienceVision, a cross-domain benchmark for scientific 3D understanding and reasoning through expert-level visual question answering (VQA). We construct 250 questions, with 50 each from Biology, Chemistry, Medical Imaging, Mechanical CAD, and Architecture, through a pipeline combining synthetic question generation with domain-expert review and annotation. Each task pairs a native 3D artifact with a scientific question, a specified response format, and a task-specific reference answer, requiring domain knowledge to be applied to geometric or topological evidence. We evaluate 12 models on the same questions in three settings: visual question answering with native 3D artifacts accessed through an agent harness's file and code-execution tools; the same workflow augmented with expert-inspired viewer inspection and measurement tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP); and visual question answering from prescribed rendered 2D images using an agent harness. All settings use the same task-specific deterministic final-answer scoring. The inspection environment supports view changes, target isolation, and slice inspection. In this main comparison, the best mean answer score is 0.53 out of 1. Mean scores in the native-artifact workflow without additional MCP tools exceed those in the rendered-image workflow for every model, by 17.2 percentage points on average.

AI.title_zh: ScienceVision：人工智能能否像科学家一样观察与推理？
AI.abstract_zh: 科学发现建立在对观测结果的准确获取之上，并通过领域知识与推理加以解读。对于科学3D数据而言，这要求理解结构与空间关系，从蛋白质接触（protein contacts）到解剖学组织（anatomical organization）。现有的多模态基准（multimodal benchmarks）主要评估文本与2D图像，而科学3D评估在各学科之间的表示形式与协议各不相同，限制了跨学科比较。为评估这些基础能力，我们提出ScienceVision，一个通过专家级视觉问答（visual question answering, VQA）来评估科学3D理解与推理的跨领域基准（cross-domain benchmark）。我们构建了250个问题，生物学（Biology）、化学（Chemistry）、医学影像（Medical Imaging）、机械CAD（Mechanical CAD）和建筑学（Architecture）各50个，构建流程将合成问题生成与领域专家评审及标注相结合。每个任务将一个原生3D工件（native 3D artifact）与一个科学问题、指定的回答格式以及任务特定的参考答案配对，要求将领域知识应用于几何或拓扑证据。我们在三种设置下用相同的问题评估了12个模型：通过智能体框架（agent harness）的文件与代码执行工具访问原生3D工件进行视觉问答；在同一工作流中通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）增加受专家启发的查看与测量工具；以及使用智能体框架基于规定的渲染2D图像进行视觉问答。所有设置均使用相同的任务特定确定性最终答案评分。该检查环境支持视角切换、目标隔离和切片检查。在这一主要比较中，最佳平均答案得分为1分中的0.53分。对于每一个模型，在无额外MCP工具的原生工件工作流中，平均得分均超过渲染图像工作流，平均高出17.2个百分点。

title: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
summary: Recent work has improved computer-use agents (CUAs) by combining retrieved task-relevant tutorials and look-ahead planning using world models with MLLM judges. However, the contribution of each component -- tutorials, the judge, and the world model -- to overall improvement has not been evaluated in isolation. To fill this gap, we first construct OSWorld-Tutorial and ScienceBoard-Tutorial: two datasets for CUAs with curated multimodal tutorials, covering everyday and scientific domains. We then propose RAG-PolicyJudge (RAG-PJ), a policy-judge framework for CUAs conditioned on task-specific tutorials: the policy proposes candidate actions, and the judge selects among them. To isolate the effect of world models given tutorials, we compare RAG-PJ with and without common world models: using either zero-shot text-based descriptions of next states or an oracle that returns ground-truth visual observations. We find that RAG-PJ gains little benefit from these rollouts when tutorials are present, even with perfect visual futures. This suggests prior world-model gains in tutorial-conditioned methods come mainly from tutorial understanding and the judge's ability to select the proposed actions, rather than from predicted rollouts. Error analysis reveals that the bottleneck is not rollout fidelity, but the judge's ability to reason over future states and recognize task completion. This highlights the need to improve not just next-state prediction in world models, but also reasoning over their predicted rollouts. Datasets and code are available at https://github.com/realjoenguyen/RAGPJ-official.

AI.title_zh: 以教程为条件时，计算机使用智能体从世界模型中获益甚微
AI.abstract_zh: 近期工作通过将检索到的任务相关教程与借助世界模型和 MLLM 评判器（judge）进行的前瞻性规划相结合，改进了计算机使用智能体（computer-use agents，CUA）。然而，各组成部分——教程、评判器和世界模型——对整体改进的贡献尚未被孤立地评估。为填补这一空白，我们首先构建了 OSWorld-Tutorial 和 ScienceBoard-Tutorial：这是两个面向 CUA、配有精心整理的多模态教程的数据集，覆盖日常与科学领域。随后，我们提出 RAG-PolicyJudge（RAG-PJ），一个以任务特定教程为条件的 CUA 策略-评判器（policy-judge）框架：策略提出候选动作，评判器在其中进行选择。为在给定教程的条件下隔离世界模型的作用，我们比较了带有和不带有常见世界模型的 RAG-PJ：或使用对下一状态的零样本（zero-shot）文本描述，或使用返回真值视觉观测的 oracle。我们发现，在存在教程时，RAG-PJ 从这些推演（rollouts）中获益甚微，即使拥有完美的视觉未来也是如此。这表明，以往在以教程为条件的方法中世界模型带来的增益主要来自教程理解以及评判器选择所提出动作的能力，而非来自预测的推演。错误分析揭示，瓶颈不在于推演的保真度，而在于评判器对未来状态进行推理以及识别任务完成的能力。这凸显出不仅需要改进世界模型中的下一状态预测，还需要改进对其预测推演的推理。数据集与代码见 https://github.com/realjoenguyen/RAGPJ-official。

title: Compression Forcing: Hierarchical History Tokenization Enables Flexible World Models
summary: Effective world modeling requires compressing salient history information that facilitates future prediction. However, most existing approaches inherit tokenization and conditioning mechanisms from video generation, where objectives are centered around perceptual realism rather than predictive utility. This discrepancy limits the world model's effectiveness, especially in environments dominated by visual nuisances or task-irrelevant background details. To this end, we introduce Compression Forcing (CF), a general framework that aligns history compression with the predictive objective of world modeling. Compression Forcing features Dynamics-Aware Tokenization (DAT), a novel tokenization method that compresses history observations into a sequence ordered by decreasing dynamics saliency. Built on a diffusion backbone, this structure enables Hierarchical History Guidance (HG-H), allowing selective amplification of dynamics-salient information during inference. Extensive experiments across various environments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity, physical realism, and downstream decision-making performance, establishing Compression Forcing as a highly flexible and effective approach for world modeling.

AI.title_zh: 压缩强制：层级化历史分词实现灵活的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 有效的世界建模需要压缩有助于未来预测的显著历史信息。然而，大多数现有方法沿用视频生成中的分词与条件化机制，而视频生成的目标围绕感知真实感而非预测效用。这一差异限制了世界模型的有效性，尤其是在由视觉干扰或与任务无关的背景细节所主导的环境中。为此，我们提出压缩强制（Compression Forcing, CF），这是一个将历史压缩与世界建模的预测目标对齐的通用框架。压缩强制具有动态感知分词（Dynamics-Aware Tokenization, DAT），这是一种新颖的分词方法，它将历史观测压缩为按动态显著性递减顺序排列的序列。基于扩散骨干网络，该结构实现了层级化历史引导（Hierarchical History Guidance, HG-H），允许在推理时选择性地放大动态显著信息。在多种环境下的大量实验表明，该方法在预测保真度、物理真实感以及下游决策性能方面均有提升，从而确立了压缩强制作为一种高度灵活且有效的世界建模方法。

title: Physical Experience Builds Continual Spatial World Models
summary: World models are increasingly used to support prediction and planning in embodied agents, but the knowledge is usually established before deployment and then carried into later encounters. Continual operation faces a different problem. A familiar environment may change, and the agent must use previous experience without allowing old expectations to override current physical evidence. This study asks what repeated physical experience must contribute for a spatial world model to become progressively more useful rather than simply more persistent. A physics-grounded dynamic maze separates recurring spatial change from the continuous consequences of action. Cross-episode Spatial Change Memory learns relations among environmental transformations, while state-action-outcome experience refines predictions of motion. Structured experience progressively reduces the need for future route correction and transfers to spatial transitions not encountered during learning. The advantage disappears when past changes contain no information about future ones. Continuous navigation further shows that predictive memory changes behavior when a previous decision becomes invalid but leaves behavior unchanged when the decision remains correct. Physical tests expose a complementary limit: correct topology does not guarantee correct action prediction, and accumulated physical experience reduces this mismatch within the modeled dynamics. The results characterize continual world knowledge as experience that improves future prediction and action beyond stored episodes while remaining revisable by the physical outcomes it is intended to predict.

AI.title_zh: 物理经验构建持续的空间世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型日益被用于支持具身智能体中的预测与规划，但其知识通常是在部署之前建立，然后被带入后续的遭遇之中。持续运行面临的是另一个问题。一个熟悉的环境可能发生变化，智能体必须利用先前的经验，同时不能让旧的预期压过当前的物理证据。本研究追问：重复的物理经验必须贡献什么，才能使空间世界模型逐步变得更有用，而不仅仅是更加顽固。一个以物理为基础的动态迷宫将反复出现的空间变化与行动的持续后果分离开来。跨回合空间变化记忆（Cross-episode Spatial Change Memory）学习环境变换之间的关系，而状态—行动—结果经验则精化对运动的预测。结构化的经验逐步减少了对未来路线纠正的需求，并能迁移到学习期间未曾遇到的空间转变上。当过去的变化不包含关于未来变化的信息时，这一优势便消失了。连续导航进一步表明，预测性记忆在先前决策变得无效时会改变行为，而在决策仍然正确时则使行为保持不变。物理测试揭示了一个互补的局限：正确的拓扑结构并不能保证正确的行动预测，而积累的物理经验在建模的动力学范围内减小了这一失配。这些结果将持续性世界知识刻画为这样一种经验：它改善未来的预测与行动，超越已存储的回合，同时仍可被它旨在预测的物理结果所修正。

title: Decision Transformer with Task-Aware Representations for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
summary: To enable effective generalization in offline meta-RL, it is essential to accurately infer the underlying task through latent task representations, which provide a compact and transferable summary of task-specific characteristics for guiding policy generation. In this paper, we propose Contrastive Task-Aware Decision Transformer (CoTA-DT), a DT-based offline meta-RL framework that learns task representations by jointly integrating four complementary components: (i) contrastive learning from offline trajectories, (ii) alignment with natural-language task descriptions, (iii) one-step supervision via a task-conditioned world model, and (iv) long-term supervision via a task-conditioned Q function. The learned task representations are used as conditioning signals for a DT-based policy, enabling task-aware meta-policy learning. To further support generalization in both zero-shot and few-shot settings, we design a language-grounded, self-adaptive strategy that enables effective and reliable adaptation to unseen tasks. Notably, in CoTA-DT, the pretrained LLM serves as a shared backbone for language encoding, world modeling, Q-function estimation, and policy learning. This unified design facilitates parameter sharing, improving both efficiency and generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse offline meta-RL benchmarks demonstrate that CoTA-DT consistently outperforms prior methods, particularly in challenging zero-shot generalization scenarios.

AI.title_zh: 面向离线元强化学习的任务感知表示决策Transformer
AI.abstract_zh: 为了在离线元强化学习（offline meta-RL）中实现有效的泛化，关键在于通过潜在任务表示准确推断底层任务，这类表示提供了任务特定特征的紧凑且可迁移的摘要，用以指导策略生成。本文提出对比式任务感知决策Transformer（Contrastive Task-Aware Decision Transformer, CoTA-DT），这是一个基于DT的离线元强化学习框架，它通过联合整合四个互补组件来学习任务表示：(i) 从离线轨迹中进行对比学习，(ii) 与自然语言任务描述对齐，(iii) 通过任务条件化的世界模型进行单步监督，以及 (iv) 通过任务条件化的Q函数进行长期监督。所学到的任务表示被用作基于DT的策略的条件信号，从而实现任务感知的元策略学习。为了进一步支持零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（few-shot）设定下的泛化，我们设计了一种基于语言、自适应的策略，使其能够有效且可靠地适应未见过的任务。值得注意的是，在CoTA-DT中，预训练的LLM作为语言编码、世界建模、Q函数估计和策略学习的共享主干网络。这种统一设计促进了参数共享，同时提升了效率和泛化能力。在多种离线元强化学习基准上的大量实验表明，CoTA-DT始终优于先前方法，尤其是在具有挑战性的零样本泛化场景中。

title: Controlling Action-Head Co-Adaptation to VLM Representation Anisotropy
summary: Modern learning systems increasingly combine pretrained models with downstream heads. Despite the growing importance of such modular designs, how the downstream model co-adapts to the geometry of pretrained representations remains relatively underexplored. We study this problem through vision-language-action models (VLAs), where a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) conditions an action model for control. We find that the action model progressively concentrates its sensitivity on high-variance dimensions of the VLM outputs. Through controlled experiments across different backbone-head models, we further show that counteracting this sensitivity concentration can be beneficial under representation--task mismatch settings. Motivated by these observations, we introduce \emph{Adaptive Interface Equalizer} (AdaIE), a parameter-free mechanism that reweights pretrained representations according to the evolving downstream sensitivity during training. AdaIE improves VLA success rates on simulation benchmarks, with gains of up to $+5.28$ percentage points (pp) on RoboCasa-GR1 and $+1.68$ pp on RoboTwin 2.0, and achieves an average gain of $+19$ pp across five real-world manipulation tasks. It further generalizes to diffusion policies and world models, improving downstream performance in both settings. Our results highlight interface co-adaptation as an important optimization problem when coupling pretrained representations with downstream models.

AI.title_zh: 控制动作头对VLM表征各向异性的协同适应
AI.abstract_zh: 现代学习系统越来越多地将预训练模型与下游头（heads）相结合。尽管此类模块化设计日益重要，下游模型如何协同适应预训练表征的几何结构仍相对缺乏探索。我们通过视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）研究这一问题，其中预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）为控制任务的动作模型提供条件。我们发现，动作模型会逐步将其敏感性集中于VLM输出的高方差维度上。通过在不同骨干-头（backbone-head）模型上的受控实验，我们进一步表明，在表征—任务不匹配（representation--task mismatch）的设定下，抵消这种敏感性集中可能是有益的。受这些观察启发，我们提出了\emph{自适应接口均衡器}（Adaptive Interface Equalizer，AdaIE），这是一种无参数机制，在训练过程中依据不断演变的下游敏感性对预训练表征重新加权。AdaIE在仿真基准上提升了VLA的成功率，在RoboCasa-GR1上提升最高达$+5.28$个百分点（pp），在RoboTwin 2.0上提升$+1.68$ pp，并在五个真实世界操作任务上取得平均$+19$ pp的提升。它进一步可推广到扩散策略（diffusion policies）和世界模型（world models），在两种设定下均提升了下游性能。我们的结果凸显了接口协同适应（interface co-adaptation）在将预训练表征与下游模型耦合时是一个重要的优化问题。

title: FlowBench: Counterfactual Imagination Training for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Humans imagine scene changes under hypothetical motions, an ability central to spatial reasoning and robotic planning. However, this capability remains underexplored in vision-language models and world models. We formalize this capability as Counterfactual Spatial Imagination (CSI) and introduce FlowBench, a resource for training and evaluating both, with 428K training examples spanning simulated and real-world scenes, household environments and tabletop manipulation, and diverse question types. A scalable, fully automatic pipeline pairs each hypothetical motion with spatial questions and, in simulation, exact outcome frames and optical flow. For VLMs, proprietary models exhibit an imagination gap, performing worse when motion outcomes must be inferred than when observed, and open-source models perform near chance; fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B on FlowBench-Sim-Train raises its accuracy by 29.5 percentage points in simulation and 16.9 on real images, a strong sim-to-real transfer. For world models, training on FlowBench-Sim improves text-to-flow prediction for all four model families we test, raising the accuracy of Psi-0.6 from 52.1% to 61.7%. FlowBench thus serves as a training and evaluation resource for both. Code and datasets are released at https://github.com/liuyifan22/FlowBench.

AI.title_zh: FlowBench：面向空间智能的反事实想象训练
AI.abstract_zh: 人类能够在假设性运动下想象场景变化，这一能力是空间推理与机器人规划的核心。然而，这一能力在视觉-语言模型与世界模型中仍未得到充分探索。我们将该能力形式化为反事实空间想象（Counterfactual Spatial Imagination, CSI），并推出 FlowBench——一个同时用于训练与评估该能力的资源，包含 428K 个训练样例，涵盖仿真与真实场景、家庭环境与桌面操作，以及多样的问题类型。一个可扩展的全自动流程为每个假设性运动配以空间问题，并在仿真中配以精确的结果帧与光流。对于视觉-语言模型（VLM），专有模型表现出想象差距：当必须推断运动结果时，其表现不如直接观察时；而开源模型的表现接近随机水平；在 FlowBench-Sim-Train 上微调 Qwen3-VL-8B，使其在仿真中准确率提升 29.5 个百分点，在真实图像上提升 16.9，展现出很强的仿真到现实迁移。对于世界模型，在 FlowBench-Sim 上训练可改善我们测试的全部四个模型系列的文本到光流预测，将 Psi-0.6 的准确率从 52.1% 提升至 61.7%。因此，FlowBench 可作为二者的训练与评估资源。代码与数据集发布于 https://github.com/liuyifan22/FlowBench。

title: Self-Consistent Neural Control: Learning Trajectories for Implicit Equilibrium
summary: One big challenge in physical AI is interacting with systems whose states are defined by implicit equilibrium. Learning in these systems is difficult because their responses can be multistable, path-dependent, and sensitive over long horizons. Adjoint learning provides an efficient way to optimize trajectories without unrolling iterative equilibrium solvers, but its gradient relies on the frozen-tangent approximation, which neglects higher-order sensitivity terms and can become inaccurate when the local equilibrium varies rapidly. In this work, we introduce Self-Consistent Neural Control (SCNC), optimizing trajectories along which sensitivity variations are explicitly controlled. We derive a mathematical bound on the resulting gradient error and develop a practical finite-difference approximation. We validate the framework on deformable objects, which are representative of implicit equilibrium systems, ranging from simple quadratic energy models such as elastic rods to complex systems including thin-walled tubes, measuring tapes, and Slinky-like structures. Compared with the adjoint learning and the gradient-free iCEM baselines, SCNC achieves faster convergence and more stable optimization by reducing switching to undesirable equilibrium branches, doubling the stable optimization rate over adjoint learning 83.3% vs. 41.7% and reducing the average loss by more than 1.5 orders of magnitude on thin-walled tubes, where sensitivity variations are pronounced.

AI.title_zh: 自洽神经控制：面向隐式平衡的学习轨迹
AI.abstract_zh: 物理人工智能中的一大挑战是与状态由隐式平衡（implicit equilibrium）所定义的系统进行交互。在这类系统中学习十分困难，因为其响应可能具有多稳态性、路径依赖性，并且在长时程上敏感。伴随学习（adjoint learning）提供了一种无需展开迭代平衡求解器即可优化轨迹的高效方法，但其梯度依赖于冻结切线近似（frozen-tangent approximation），该近似忽略了高阶敏感性项，当局部平衡变化迅速时会变得不准确。在本工作中，我们提出自洽神经控制（Self-Consistent Neural Control，SCNC），沿其显式控制敏感性变化的轨迹进行优化。我们推导了所得梯度误差的数学界，并开发了一种实用的有限差分近似。我们在可变形物体上验证了该框架，这些物体是隐式平衡系统的代表性实例，范围从诸如弹性杆之类的简单二次能量模型，到包括薄壁管、卷尺以及Slinky状结构在内的复杂系统。与伴随学习和无梯度的iCEM基线相比，SCNC 通过减少向不期望平衡分支的切换，实现了更快的收敛和更稳定的优化：在敏感性变化显著的薄壁管上，其稳定优化率相比伴随学习提高了一倍，为 83.3% 对 41.7%，并将平均损失降低了超过 1.5 个数量级。

title: TaoMate-FVSR: Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
summary: Low-quality facial videos suffer from missing fine details, while AI-generated videos may additionally contain implausible teeth and lip movements that do not match the speech. Restoring the mouth region is particularly challenging: enhancing existing details can preserve structural errors, whereas regenerating them risks changing facial identity and articulation. We propose an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that reconstructs unreliable mouth details and aligns lip movements with the speech while preserving facial identity and temporal consistency. Built on a video diffusion transformer, our framework mixes input video latents with noise to retain useful source information while allowing corrupted details to be regenerated. Audio guides lip movements, reference images constrain facial appearance, and previously generated frames promote temporal consistency. We train the model in two stages, first learning visual restoration from degraded images and videos, then learning audio-guided lip correction from degraded dubbed videos. The resulting model supports both restoration with the original audio and visual dubbing with replacement audio. On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the lowest LPIPS and DISTS and the best lip synchronization scores among the evaluated restoration baselines. Qualitative results on AI-generated videos further show improvements in facial detail and mouth-region appearance, including clearer tooth boundaries and lip contours.

AI.title_zh: TaoMate-FVSR：音频引导的面部视频修复
AI.abstract_zh: 低质量面部视频存在精细细节缺失的问题，而AI生成的视频还可能包含与语音不匹配的、不合理的牙齿和唇部运动。修复嘴部区域尤其具有挑战性：增强现有细节可能会保留结构性错误，而重新生成则可能改变面部身份和发音。我们提出了一种音频引导的面部视频修复框架，该框架重建不可靠的嘴部细节并使唇部运动与语音对齐，同时保持面部身份和时间一致性。该框架构建于视频扩散Transformer之上，将输入视频潜变量与噪声混合，以保留有用的源信息，同时允许损坏的细节被重新生成。音频引导唇部运动，参考图像约束面部外观，先前生成的帧促进时间一致性。我们分两个阶段训练模型：首先从退化的图像和视频中学习视觉修复，然后从退化的配音视频中学习音频引导的唇部校正。所得模型同时支持使用原始音频的修复以及使用替换音频的视觉配音。在说话头修复基准上，我们的方法在所评估的修复基线中取得了最低的LPIPS和DISTS以及最佳的唇同步分数。在AI生成视频上的定性结果进一步显示了面部细节和嘴部区域外观的改善，包括更清晰的牙齿边界和唇部轮廓。

title: ReVi: Recursive Recap Video Generation
summary: Novels tell rich stories, but their textual form cannot directly present the sights and sounds of the worlds they describe. Film adaptations offer an audiovisual experience but require substantial production effort and viewing time; film recaps are shorter but depend on existing footage. Neither route directly provides a concise audiovisual account of a novel. We therefore study novel-to-recap video generation: producing a self-contained, source-grounded audiovisual retelling directly from a novel within a fixed viewing-time budget. This task requires compressing the story while preserving causal connections, allocating sufficient time to retained events, and aligning narration with newly generated visuals. We propose ReVi, a dual-loop multi-agent framework guided by edit first, generate second. Its Inner Loop plans story content, narration time, and corresponding shots before video generation. Across novels, its Outer Loop performs recursive self-improvement by revising both the editing policy and the meta policy that governs its revision. Experiments on two evaluation sets show that ReVi improves recap quality and duration compliance over representative baselines, with human ratings and multi-round improvement results providing further support.

AI.title_zh: ReVi：递归式回顾视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 小说讲述内容丰富的故事，但其文本形式无法直接呈现其所描绘世界中的景象与声音。影视改编提供了视听体验，但需要大量制作投入和观看时间；影视回顾（film recaps）更短，但依赖于已有的影像素材。这两条路径都无法直接提供对一部小说的简明视听叙述。因此，我们研究小说到回顾视频生成（novel-to-recap video generation）：在固定的观看时间预算内，直接从一部小说生成自成一体、以原著为依据的视听复述。该任务要求在保留因果联系的同时压缩故事，为保留的事件分配充足的时间，并使旁白与最新生成的画面相对齐。我们提出 ReVi，一个由"先编辑、后生成"（edit first, generate second）引导的双环多智能体框架。其内环（Inner Loop）在视频生成之前规划故事内容、旁白时间和相应的镜头。在不同小说之间，其外环（Outer Loop）通过修正编辑策略以及支配其修正的元策略（meta policy）来执行递归式自我改进。在两个评估集上的实验表明，ReVi 在回顾质量和时长符合度上优于代表性基线，人类评分与多轮改进结果提供了进一步的支持。
